_about: Rules for check_release_text.py. Edit freely. level FAIL blocks a release, WARN asks a person to read the line. pattern and allow are Python regexes (JSON-escaped: write \b for a word boundary). allow excuses a whole line for that rule. group core always runs; other groups only with --group <name>. Dashes are written as \u escapes so this file stays plain ASCII.

rules.message: em dash, use a colon, comma or parentheses
en dash, use a plain hyphen for ranges, otherwise a colon, comma or parentheses
dash character, use a colon, comma or parentheses
a hyphen used as a dash between words, use a colon, comma or parentheses

rules.pattern: \b(as an ai|as a language model|i hope this helps|let me know if you('d| would)? like|here is (the|a|your) (updated|revised|rewritten|improved)|certainly!|great question)
rules.message: assistant chat text left in a public file

rules.pattern: \b(delve[sd]?|delving|tapestry|seamless(ly)?|elevates?|elevated|elevating|unleash(es|ed)?|game[- ]chang(er|ing)|cutting[- ]edge|embark(s|ed)?|dive into|deep dive|it'?s worth noting|it is worth noting|in conclusion|look no further|testament to|ever[- ]evolving|revolutioni[sz]e[sd]?|next level|whether you'?re|immersive experience|rest assured|meticulous(ly)?|meticulously crafted|leverag(e|es|ed|ing)|plethora|myriad|realm of|symphony of|navigate the|in today'?s|breathes? new life|nestled|bustling|captivating|unparalleled|transformative|elevate your|enhance your)\b
rules.message: filler or AI-sounding wording, say the concrete thing instead

rules.pattern: \b(fixes all|never crash(es)?|100% (compatible|stable|safe)|compatible with (everything|all mods)|works with every|zero (bugs|crashes)|bug[- ]free)\b
rules.message: claims more than a test can prove
